fire: A bolt of lightning can jump between a cloud and the earth in a fraction of a second.

Meteorologists classify flashes as intracloud, between two clouds, or between a cloud and the ground.
During the storm, sparks of lightning flickered between a cloud and the hills to the west.
Pilots fear discharges between a cloud and the earth more than flashes inside the storm.
In a thunderstorm, charge builds until a channel forms between a cloud and the surface.
The camera caught a stroke of lightning running between a cloud and the sea.
Ground flashes, which travel between a cloud and the earth, are the most dangerous kind.

Ground flashes, which strike trees and towers, are the most dangerous kind.
